name.ja: セインティック・リンカー

requirement.en: During your Main Phase that you Special Summoned this card, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.

effect.en: Return 1 face-up card from your opponent's field to the owner's hand. Then, if you have 3 or more different Monster Types in your Graveyard, this card inflicts piercing battle damage this turn. This turn, you cannot activate the effect of "Saintick Linker".

materials.en: "Riel the Dimensional Sworn Ally" + 1 Level 8 LIGHT Attribute Cyberse Type  monster
